unit_title: ምዕራፍ ፬ — Meraf 4: Advanced Mastery of ወ and ተ

success_screen.headline_en: Stellar! You solved the advanced ወ and ተ challenges!
success_screen.headline_am: ድንቅ ነው! የላቁትን የወ እና የተ ፈተናዎችን በብልሃት ጨረሱ!

games.title: Word Assembly: ወፍ
games.instructions_en: Assemble the letters to build the word for Bird!
games.tips_en: Tip: Select the first form 'ወ' first, then end with 'ፍ'!

games.title: Word Finish: ተማሪ
games.instructions_en: Look at the incomplete word for 'Student': ተ[ ? ]ሪ. Choose the correct missing middle letter!
games.tips_en: The full word is ተማሪ (pronounced Te-ma-ri).

games.title: Audio Blend: ዊ
games.instructions_en: Listen closely to the sound blend. Which symbol represents the exact 'Wi' sound you hear?
games.target_phonetic_description: The 3rd form ('I' vowel sound): 'Wi' as in 'Window'

games.title: Word Assembly: ተራራ
games.tips_en: Tip: Start with first form 'ተ', followed by 'ራ', and end with the second 'ራ'!

games.title: Word Finish: ውሻ
games.instructions_en: Find the missing letter to complete the word for 'Dog': ው[ ? ].
games.tips_en: The full word is ውሻ (pronounced Wu-sha).

games.title: Audio Blend: ቱ
games.instructions_en: Listen closely. Which symbol represents the 'Tu' sound?

games.title: Word Assembly: ዋንጫ
games.tips_en: Tip: Start with fourth form 'ዋ', middle 'ን', and end with 'ጫ'!

games.title: Word Finish: ወንበር
games.tips_en: The full word is ወንበር (pronounced Wen-ber).
